_help: Every J.A.R.V.I.G. feature and whether it is in beta. status is "beta" or "stable". A beta skill turns the HUD violet and starts its replies with "You've requested a BETA Feature."; a beta service gets a BETA tag in the Systems panel; a beta mode (private mode) keeps the HUD violet while it is on and says the BETA line once, when switching. To take a feature out of beta, set its status to "stable" once its ready_when condition is met. Changes apply without a restart.
